title: 西湖清晨：比传说更安静｜断桥·欲把西湖比西子 West Lake at Dawn
description:
你会为了一片安静的湖，早起一次吗？评论区告诉我。

清晨五点的西湖，还没醒。雾在水上，桥在雾里——这是断桥，民间《白蛇传》里白娘子等许仙的地方。九百年前，苏轼在杭州当通判，为这片湖写下最有名的一句："欲把西湖比西子，淡妆浓抹总相宜。"从此"西子湖"成了西湖的别称。游人如织的白天是浓抹，而清晨空无一人的西湖，就是那抹淡妆——素净，却最像它自己。

Five a.m. at West Lake, and the lake hasn't woken. Mist sits on the water; a bridge floats in the fog — this is 断桥 (Broken Bridge), where, in the folk Legend of the White Snake, the white-snake spirit waited for her love. Nine hundred years ago the poet Su Shi served as an official in Hangzhou and gave the lake its most famous line: "Compare West Lake to the beauty Xi Shi — plain or painted, she is always lovely." That is why the lake is nicknamed 西子湖. The crowded daytime is her painted face; the empty dawn is her plain one — bare, and most truly herself.

本片无旁白：以中英双语字幕叙述，配免版税音乐。/ No voiceover — narrated through bilingual subtitles over a royalty-free music bed (no AI narration in this video).
